title: Prohibition PSV-039 1st Edition Yu-Gi-Oh Pharaoh's Servant Magic Card 1996
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
Prohibition – Yu-Gi-Oh! Pharaoh's Servant – PSV-039 – 1st Edition
You will receive the exact card pictured. These are photos of the actual card, not stock images. Front, back, and close-ups of all four corners are shown.
Card details
Name: Prohibition
Set: Pharaoh's Servant (PSV)
Card number: PSV-039
Edition: 1st Edition
Card type: Magic Card (Continuous)
Passcode: 43711255
Copyright: © 1996 Kazuki Takahashi
Card text:
When you play this card, declare the name of 1 card. As long as this card remains on the field, the declared card cannot be played. The cards which are already on the field before this card's activation are excluded.
Note for collectors: this is an early printing that reads "MAGIC CARD" rather than "Spell Card". Konami renamed Magic Cards to Spell Cards in 2002, so the Magic Card wording only appears on the earlier print runs.
Condition: Ungraded, in the condition shown. Please review all photos closely and judge for yourself – the images are of the actual card and are the most accurate description of its condition. Corner close-ups are included so you can assess edge and corner wear directly.
